new_results: Global majority-plane Gaussian-location theorem: for J=diag(1,1,-1), isotropic G~N(0,sI3), and arbitrary independent M supported in the positive eigenspace, the complete density of (G+M)^TJ(G+M) is at most 1/(2sqrt(2)s). Positive sheet is the completed account02/B17 one-sheet theorem; negative sheet follows from Q=U-V and monotonicity of the Gaussian-square density.
Exact entrywise-dense 4m-variable rank-three family A_m=R_m B R_m^T has nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}; two positive-eigenspace physical row types carry source-valid root-m Poisson satellites.

Pinned Theorem F applies in the actual physical frame with leverage 3/(4m), Gram I3 and zero residual, giving |Phi_m(t)|<=min(1,(4pi)^(3/2)|t|^(-3/2)), finite-stage ||p_m||_infinity<=12, and uniform convergence of complete output densities to the Gaussian-plus-Poisson limit.

For fixed D>0 and a=sqrt(D/lambda), the special marginal variance tends to 1/12+D and vector Lindeberg defect tends to (3/2)D while the lower witness tends to 3sqrt(2) as lambda->0. At lambda=10^-3,D=1 the bracket is [4.234166002454733,4.242640687119286].

Diagonal vanishing-intensity variant lambda_m=m^(-1/4), a_m=m^(1/4) has Var(X_special) and Lindeberg defect diverging like m^(1/4) while ||p_Qm||_infinity->3sqrt(2). Thus moment/Lindeberg rigidity is false outside the previous explicitly Lindeberg chamber.

partner_result_applied.application: its Gaussian-location one-sheet inequality is the positive-sheet half of the new global majority-plane theorem, which then yields limsup ||p_m||_infinity<=3sqrt(2) for the explicit dense Poisson-satellite target family

unresolved_implication: The full arbitrary-product theorem remains open. The next sharp-witness regimes are simultaneous majority/minority macroscopic shifts, shared non-collinear macroscopic rows not reducible to a positive-plane location mixture, and extra active spectrum surviving aggregation.
